RecoveryPointPolicy.description: Default recovery point selection for a recovery configuration profile.

backupType.description: The explicit, non-empty list of unique backup mechanisms to consider. Random selection cannot include Log, even when other mechanisms are also selected.

endTime.description: The inclusive upper time bound. Required with startTime for Random selection when lookbackDuration is omitted; optional for Latest selection. Mutually exclusive with lookbackDuration.

lookbackDuration.description: A positive, fixed ISO 8601 duration for relative Random selection, such as P10D or PT12H. Only days, hours, minutes, and seconds are supported; calendar-dependent months and years are not supported. Mutually exclusive with startTime and endTime. The service resolves the duration to absolute bounds at execution time without modifying the saved profile.

recoveryPointHealthStatus.description: The health filter for discrete recovery points. Omission means All. Log and point-in-time recovery candidates are not health-filtered.

startTime.description: The inclusive lower time bound. Required with endTime for Random selection when lookbackDuration is omitted; optional for Latest selection. Mutually exclusive with lookbackDuration.

type.description: The recovery point selection policy type.

RegionalObjectives.description: Recovery objectives targeted by a goal assignment for regional resiliency.

targetRecoveryPointObjective.description: Target regional recovery point objective. eg, PT15M for 15 minutes.

targetRecoveryTimeObjective.description: Target regional recovery time objective. eg, PT1H for 1 hour.

slis.description: The SLIs selected for Drill monitoring. Maximum of two entries: at most one Availability and one Latency. Duplicate types or duplicate SLI Ids are rejected.

SliSelection.description: A single SLI selected for Drill monitoring.

sliId.description: Full ARM Id of the SLI.

type.description: User-declared category of the SLI. Must be unique across the selected SLIs.
